base_analysis.semantic_identity: science museum exhibition poster about time, matter, and human curiosity

observations.description: Centered figure with massive display typography 'PROMPTS' occupying upper field as environmental mass, creating asymmetric balance with lower text block
Foreground occlusion with classical columns and objects entering frame from upper left and right edges, creating layered depth and immersion
Cinematic rim lighting separating subject from teal background, warm key light on face and hands, atmospheric haze
Teal-green dominant environment with amber/gold accents, high contrast between cool background and warm foreground objects
Overscale display type 'PROMPTS' and 'Creative DB' integrated into scene as environmental mass, with tight stacked microcopy at top
Levitating thematic object cluster: classical columns, pocket watch, old book, fountain pen, lightbulb sketch, and mushroom mug arranged around subject
Diagonal flow from upper left to lower right created by column angle, gaze direction, and typography
Material contrast between warm stone/wood/gold and cool teal tile/metal/glass
Centered figure with direct camera gaze, holding focal prop (mug), wearing embroidered denim jacket
Tiled bathroom interior with vintage fixtures, creating surreal domestic-scientific hybrid space

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Exhibition title as environmental typography with diagonal flow, integrated into scene as mass
design_decision_map.rationale: Source uses massive display type as environmental counter-mass and hierarchy driver. For science museum, adapt this to exhibition name and museum branding while preserving the typography-as-environment function.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Foreground scientific artifacts (instruments, specimens, temporal devices) entering frame to create layered depth and immersion
design_decision_map.rationale: Source foreground occlusion creates spatial complexity and viewer proximity. Adapt to target-native scientific objects that belong to museum context while preserving the depth layering function.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Atmospheric perspective with target-owned color hierarchy, preserving warm-cool separation
design_decision_map.rationale: Source uses teal-green background with warm amber accents to separate planes and create mood. Adapt to museum-appropriate palette while preserving the functional temperature contrast and atmospheric depth.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Cinematic rim light and warm key light on hero, maintaining separation from background
design_decision_map.rationale: Lighting logic is category-agnostic and effectively creates hierarchy, volume, and drama. Transfer the motivated rim and key light behavior to target subject or artifact.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Material contrast between warm organic/analog surfaces and cool analytical/structural surfaces
design_decision_map.rationale: Source contrasts warm stone/wood/gold against cool tile/metal. Adapt to museum materials (brass, glass, paper, stone) that communicate time, matter, and curiosity through tactile opposition.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Levitation of science-appropriate artifacts (precision instruments, temporal devices, specimen representations, equations) clustered around hero
design_decision_map.rationale: Source object cluster creates wonder and thematic density through surreal levitation. For science museum, replace creative-design props with verified scientific artifacts that represent time, matter, and curiosity while preserving the clustered composition.

cross_category_adaptation.literal_object: classical columns, pocket watch, old book, fountain pen, lightbulb sketch, mushroom mug
cross_category_adaptation.visual_function: levitating semantic cluster expressing theme through related artifacts
cross_category_adaptation.equivalent_adaptation: levitating scientific artifacts (precision instruments, temporal devices, specimen jars, equations, optical equipment) in warm brass/glass against cool museum architecture
cross_category_adaptation.target_category_coherence: scientific instruments and museum architecture naturally belong to a science exhibition context, preserving the wonder and curiosity while replacing creative-design specificity

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Exhibition name, dates, and museum name as integrated display typography following diagonal flow
design_decision_map.rationale: Source integrates typography into scene geometry and flow. Adapt to target copy needs while preserving the typography-as-environment and directional reading functions.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Source microcopy 'DESIGN QUE IMPACTA. IDEIAS QUE VENDEM.' and brand taglines
design_decision_map.rationale: Source text is brand-specific Portuguese copy for creative services. It cannot transfer to science museum context and must be replaced with target exhibition copy.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Source focal prop (mushroom mug) and specific object identities
design_decision_map.rationale: Mushroom mug is category-specific to creative/psychedelic context and has no place in science museum exhibition. All source objects must be replaced with target-native artifacts.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Source person identity, wardrobe, and bathroom environment
design_decision_map.rationale: Source person (Neymar Jr.), denim jacket, and tiled bathroom are identity-specific and category-inappropriate. Target requires no reference person identity and a professional museum context.

flexible_areas.rationale: All source objects are category-specific to creative design and must be replaced with science-appropriate artifacts representing time, matter, and curiosity

Source person identity is protected; target may use scientist, explorer, abstract form, or artifact as hero

risks.description: Identity leakage: Source celebrity (Neymar Jr.) may unconsciously influence target subject styling or pose
risks.mitigation: Explicitly discard source person, wardrobe, and pose; use target-native figure or abstract hero with identity-safe crop

risks.description: Category mismatch: Creative-design props (mushrooms, fountain pen, denim) may leak into science context if not actively replaced
risks.mitigation: Replace all props with verified scientific instruments, specimens, or temporal devices related to time, matter, and curiosity

risks.description: Surface copy: Floating object logic may be copied without semantic fit to science theme
risks.mitigation: Ensure every levitating object directly supports exhibition thesis of time, matter, or human curiosity

risks.description: Undertransfer: Complexity may be reduced due to perceived risk of dense composition
risks.mitigation: Preserve controlled convergence and layered depth; complexity is required by brief and supported by My Eyes advisory

risks.description: Overtransfer: Exact composition coordinates or object arrangement may be traced
risks.mitigation: Rebuild composition for 4:5 portrait with new territorial logic, flow route, and object placement

open_questions.question: Should the poster feature a specific scientist/explorer figure, an abstract representation of curiosity, or focus on artifacts without a person?
Which specific scientific instruments or artifacts best represent the intersection of time, matter, and curiosity for the target audience?

provenance.notes: Reference analysis completed for live multimodal evaluation. Source is a dense surreal personal brand poster. Translation focuses on convergence, density, and typographic mass mechanisms while discarding identity, brand, and category-specific props.

confidence.rationale: Reference provides clear visual evidence for multiple transferable mechanisms. Target constraints are explicit. Cross-category translation path is well-defined with available target-native alternatives.
